_comment: The intended settings for the backend API service, in version control.
Railway reads config-as-code from the REPOSITORY ROOT, and its reference does
not document a way to point a service at a config file in a subdirectory, so
this file is not what takes effect on the platform. The mechanism that does
both selects the Dockerfile builder and names the file. See docs/deployment.md.
Leave the service's root directory at the repository root: backend/Dockerfile
copies data/, which lives outside backend/, so the build context has to be
The worker services use the SAME image and override only the start command;
see worker.railway.json and docs/deployment.md. No start command is set here
because the image's CMD already binds $PORT.
